DESCRIPTION:
Automated PBMC Isolation


Sampled offers the ultimate solution for Automated Isolation of Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells through automation


Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) are crucial components of the immune system, and their isolation from blood is essential for research in immunology, biomarker discovery, and drug development. Isolating PBMCs also allows for the identification of various immune cells, such as T cells, B cells, and natural killer cells, facilitating various therapeutic and diagnostic applications.


PBMCs are commonly isolated via density gradient centrifugation over Ficoll-Hypaque (or other density gradient), which requires precise transfers of the target blood layers without disturbing non-target blood layers. This manual, labor-intensive procedure requires skilled technicians which can lead to variability in the PBMCs that are isolated. Switching this manual procedure to a largely automated one can improve the operational efficiency of this isolation process as well as reducing the overall costs.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: RoboSep™ Non-Human Primate B Cell Isolation Kit
PRODUCT_NAME: RoboSep™ Non-Human Primate B Cell Isolation Kit
DESCRIPTION:
Easily and efficiently isolate highly purified non-human primate B cells from fresh or previously frozen non-human primate peripheral blood mononuclear cells with the EasySep™ Non-Human Primate B Cell Isolation Kit. Widely used in published research for more than 20 years, EasySep™ combines the specificity of monoclonal antibodies with the simplicity of a column-free magnetic system. Using immunomagnetic negative selection, the following unwanted cells are targeted for removal: T cells, NK cells, monocytes, granulocytes, mast cells, dendritic cells, hematopoietic progenitors, and platelets. An EasySep™ magnet is required for this protocol, and the desired cells are simply poured or pipetted into a new tube. Following magnetic cell isolation in as little as 20 minutes, the desired B cells are ready for downstream applications. This kit has been verified for use with rhesus and cynomolgus macaques. Visit www.stemcell.com/easysep for more information.


 - 1 X 10^9 Cells

This product is supplied as a 5% solution. We offer reliable, consistent products that deliver reliable, consistent results.
